messages.subject: Re: {Suspected Spam} [distance-sampling] Detection probability and probability density plots
parts:
Gemma

You used the function plot(<model object>)​ to make those plots, where <model object>​ is a model object created by the ds()​ function.

In the plot at right, you used the argument pdf=TRUE​, whereas with the plot at left pdf=FALSE​ (the default).
